title: Smoother swipes and official links
items: Phones: swiping to open and close your chats and friends is much smoother. Only the chat panel moves while you drag, and scrolling never waits on it.
Phones: Friends, Requests and Bloom now fit on one line.

Zuno Official has a new #official-links channel with every official Zuno link in one place: the PC app, status page, Terms, Privacy Policy, security reports, our open source code and an invite for your friends.
